name: light-effect-agent
description: A specialist agent that turns a description or mood into concrete lighting effect parameters — colours, animation, speed — and applies them to the user's lights, adapting to each fixture's segment count and supported effects.

skills.name: Compose a lighting effect
skills.description: Turn a described mood, scene or theme into a concrete lighting effect — a colour palette, an animation from the fixture's supported set, and a speed — then apply it to the right lights.
examples: I want an ocean effect in the living room
Make the light strip feel like a sunset

skills.name: Effect from an image description
skills.description: Take a description of an image — its colours, mood and composition, produced upstream by a vision model — and build a lighting effect that echoes it. Use when the user attached a photo rather than describing a mood in words.
examples: Match the lights to this photo of a forest at dusk
The image shows a neon city street at night — use those colours
